votes.quote: The bug: `src/formatDuration.ts:5` uses `s <= 10 ? s.toFixed(1) : Math.round(s)`. At exactly 10000ms (`s === 10`), the `<=` makes it take the decimal branch, producing `"10.0s"`. But spec.md explicitly states `10000` should give `"10s"` (the "under 10 seconds" decimal rule vs. "10 seconds up to under 60" whole-second rule puts the boundary at `s < 10`, not `s <= 10`).
